thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so:oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī:nub phyogs bde ba

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so: 1$0000300oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: steng phyogs pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing khams su: sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: shar phyogs ri bo ta la'i rtse mo ru: longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: lho nub zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog tu: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: bod yul kha ba can gyi zhing khams su: sprul pa'i sku mchog rnam lnga la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: smon lam las 'phro 'dzoms pa'i dus mtshams su: sprul sku rig 'dzin chen po la gsol ba 'debs:

❀ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: 'bral med snying ga chos kyi pho brang du: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: rang lus 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i pho brang du: yi dam thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: nub phyogs zangs mdzod dbang gi pho brang du: dam chos yid bzhin nor bu la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba'i gzhal yas su: bka' srung dbang gi ma bdun la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i brgyud 'debs rdzogs so: ༈ byang gter thugs chen 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs myur 'jug gi kha skong ni/ ❀ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ bod khams skyob pa'i gsang mdzod lnga yi bdag /rig 'dzin dngos grub rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ zab gter phyogs brgyar spel ba'i phrin las pa// chos rje sangs rgyas bstan pa la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ smin grol gdams pas skal ldan rgyud grol mdzad// mtshungs med sangs rgyas byams bzang la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ 'brel tshad don ldan thar pa'i lam mkhan mchog /byang sems sangs rgyas dpal bzang la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ gsang chen bstan pa'i nyin byed 'dren pa'i gnyen// 'jigs med nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ thabs mkhas rmad du byung ba'i rol rtsed mkhan// mkhyen ldan ngag dbang rgya mtsho la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ rdo rje theg mchog lung gi mdzod 'dzin pa// grub dbang tshe ring dbang po la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ mkhyen gnyis ye shes gting dpag dka' ba'i mdzod// dpal ldan klu grub dbang po la gsol ba 'debs// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/

snang srid bde mchog phyag rgyas 'debs pa'i mgon// dpa' bo rol pa'i rdo rje la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ gnas lugs tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i gdings dang ldan// se ston thugs mchog 'od 'bar la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ phyogs med brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ khrag 'thung chos dbyings rdo rje la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ gzhan phan mkha' khyab lam gyis 'gro ba 'dren// bla med grub mchog ngag dbang la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ byams chen thugs rje'i snang ba mkha' ltar khyab// bla ma chos grags rgya mtsho la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ gang 'dul rab 'byams chos kyi sgo mo 'byed// mkhyen ldan kun bzang ye shes la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ grub pa mchog gi bdud rtsis rtag dgyes pa// rig 'dzin pad+ma 'gyur med la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje gar gyi dbang*// chos rgyal kun bzang 'gyur med la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ 'od gsal 'khor yug yangs pa'i gzhal yas su// pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rol pa'i tshogs kyi bdag /rje btsun phrin las chos sgron la gsol= oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ brgyud pa'i man ngag dbang gi chu bo 'beb// 'gyur med bstan 'dzin dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ zab gter gsang mdzod yongs kyi sdud pa po// 'dren mchog pad+ma gar dbang la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī/ 'bral med sogs sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang karma pas so//
